body:
## Why
When PR #12 merges, GitHub closes #1 via `Closes #1`. The issue then disappears from the open-issues board query while still carrying `kb:status:review`. The label must follow the state.

## What
- In the dispatcher tick, after the open-board query, run one more query for **closed** issues on the board that still carry `kb:status:running|review|ready|todo|triage|blocked` (labels filter + `states: [CLOSED]`, `orderBy UPDATED_AT desc`, `first: 50`). For each: closed as completed → set `kb:status:done`; closed as not_planned → `kb:status:archived`. Close the open attempt in the run comment with outcome `completed` (or `blocked` for not_planned) if still open, and release its lock ref.
- Keep it to one extra GraphQL query per tick; skip the query entirely when the board has no review/running tasks and the last tick found nothing (cache in `.kanban/state.json` with the board's max `updatedAt`).
- `hkb list --all` should show these as `done`.
- Test with the fake-gh harness if #3 has merged (read its result via `hkb show 3`); otherwise a pure-function test of the reconcile decision.

## Done when
Merging a worker PR leaves the issue closed with `kb:status:done` after the next tick, and the attempt row reads `completed`.
title: Reconcile merged PRs: review/running tasks whose issue was closed get kb:status:done
